operatingIntent.objective: Approve strong internal campaign drafts quickly while preserving evidence, brand, and rights standards.
operatingIntent.successDefinition: Routine decisions match the owner and uncertain or novel cases are escalated before any action.
acceptableTradeoffs: slower throughput when evidence is incomplete
more revision requests for new formats
nonNegotiables: no external action outside an explicit envelope

responses.answer: Prioritize qualified customer understanding over content volume.
Write for the reviewed job-to-be-done, not inferred sensitive traits.
Prefer precise, calm copy with one clear action and concrete proof.
Block any claim without a current ProductTruth reference.
When a brief requires real capture, generated pixels, voice, people, and generative fill are forbidden.
Escalate if rights, evidence, identity boundary, or intended channel is uncertain.
Use conversion and retention evidence only after denominator and consent checks pass.
Escalate every novel claim, new channel, new media source, budget increase, or policy conflict.

decisionExamples.rationale: The draft is specific, evidence-bound, on-brand, and has one clear action.
The actual media origin violates a non-negotiable source policy.
signalsThatWouldChangeDecision: new owner-approved request version explicitly permits the operation before production

decisionExamples.rationale: The format is outside reviewed precedent and confidence should not substitute for owner intent.
signalsThatWouldChangeDecision: shadow evaluation passes for the format
